parallel.requirements: Recognized the clean-room requirement to reproduce the zk CLI from observed behavior and not fetch or wrap original code.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent did lengthy direct fixture/schema probing, then delegated nine behavioral probe areas to a swarm whose deliverable was specs under /tmp/specs; implementation remained pending.
parallel.implementation: No reimplementation source was created. Parent built /tmp fixture helpers and children probed command behavior; one child wrote a cli-parse spec and one wrote a new-command spec artifact, but these were not turned into code.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child outputs were integrated into /workspace. The submitted artifact retained only the original workspace files and failed artifact validation/evaluation.
parallel.verification: Parent planned a diff harness and final verify but never reached them; official evaluation completed with compile_failed and no test execution.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Implementation, build script, final executable replacement, integrated testing, and most child specs were unfinished at timeout.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room executable reimplementation task, no source-code lookup, and no wrapping of the provided binary.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single main actor explored behavior directly and kept implementation ownership locally, planning to hand-write a pure-Go clone after probes.
serial.implementation: No meaningful implementation was written; the actor created scratch notebooks and captured help/error behavior while still probing.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No source tree or compile script was assembled. The artifact included scratch probe output and the original workspace, then failed compile.
serial.verification: Verification was planned but not reached; the official evaluator reported compile_failed with all tests not run.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run was still probing parser/env/order behavior when the main turn was cancelled, leaving no executable reimplementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel understood it had to produce an original executable matching the observed zk binary and obey clean-room restrictions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received and followed the same clean-room benchmark prompt and restrictions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference; both identified the same required deliverable and constraints.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split the work into nine behavior-probing children and left implementation, build, diff, and final verification for later.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept the work in one actor and explicitly planned to hand-write the Go clone itself after probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used a spec-only swarm with no active implementation owner; serial had no delegation boundary but also delayed code until too late.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel supplied children a common fixture, reference help captures, and separate probe areas, but their handoff target was written specs rather than implementation contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept discoveries in one context and did not need cross-agent handoff or interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced handoff and shared-state boundaries; serial avoided them but had less aggregate functional coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel cracked a working database fixture, captured help text, and delegated detailed command probes, but did not implement source code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial stayed mostly on parser, init, config, and environment-order probes and likewise did not start code before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel achieved deeper behavioral discovery through subagents, while serial remained shallower; neither converted observations into a runnable reimplementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The blocking AgentSwarm returned after parent cancellation with only one child completed and eight aborted.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; its main actor was simply cancelled at the end of probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost planned child outputs through the child-result lifecycle, while serial had a single unfinished local trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote scratch/spec files and shared TodoList state visibly bled across agents, but no implementation merge reached /workspace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote only local scratch probe artifacts such as /workspace/t1 and had no cross-agent workspace merge.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared-state coordination noise and unintegrated specs; serial had no concurrent write boundary but still left probe artifacts instead of a solution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel listed a diff harness and final verification as pending tasks but never reached them before compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial planned to implement and verify later but was still probing when cancelled, so no acceptance evidence existed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run performed final acceptance; parallel deferred verification behind its swarm, while serial deferred it behind more local probes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 425 LLM requests, 492 tool calls, nine subagents, and timed out with a cancelled swarm.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 58 LLM requests, 78 tool calls, no subagents, and also timed out during main-agent probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the same wall-clock budget, but parallel spent much more coordination budget and closed with unresolved child work.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official records are not discordant: both parallel and serial have solution_passed=false, error_code=compile_failed, and 0/1473 passed. The substantive difference is process, not outcome. Parallel discovered more of the functional surface by building a sqlite fixture and delegating nine probe areas, but that work remained outside the final implementation path. Serial made a narrower single-agent pass over CLI/config behavior and likewise ran out of time before writing code.
parallel_contributors: Spec-only swarm left no active implementation owner during the only delegated phase.
Eight of nine children were cancelled before returning completed specs.
No integrated source, build script, or verified replacement executable was produced.
serial_contributors: Single actor spent the full budget on probing and parser/config detail.
Implementation and verification remained pending when the main turn was cancelled.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel learned more real functional database/list/tag/graph behavior than serial by reconstructing a working fixture.
Serial focused more on CLI parser, init, config, and terminal prompt details but did not reach code generation.
evaluator_effects: Both artifacts failed before testcase execution, so testcase score gives no behavioral granularity.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained labels explain parallel process loss and not a discordant pass/fail result

candidates.reason: The parent launched a blocking nine-child probing swarm, and the run cancelled active child turns before most children finalized or returned their required spec handoffs. The aggregate result reported one completed child and eight aborted children. The corrective boundary was to collect usable checkpoints or let active children finalize their required specs before exhausting the run.
candidates.realized_consequence: Eight child investigations were terminated before completed specs reached the parent, leaving the parent without the planned behavior corpus for implementation.
candidates.near_match_reason: The directly observed transition is cancellation of active children before results finalized; there was no later parent decision window in which completed failed-child output was ignored instead of taken over.
